theme.vibe: Authority, Clarity, Truth. Enterprise-grade technical precision, refined Google/Perplexity experience.

rules.headings: Use tracking-tight for H1/H2. Never center by default. Left-align for editorial feel.
rules.hierarchy: H1: text-5xl to text-6xl for main hero search prompt. Body: text-base to text-lg. Monospace for metadata/stats.
rules.import: Import these fonts via Google Fonts (or Fontshare for Cabinet Grotesk) in index.css.

colors.rules: No soft gradients. Use stark contrasts. 95% of UI should be monochrome, color exists only for data/action focus (e.g. International Klein Blue for AI highlights).

spacing_and_layout.scale: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers must have internal padding to avoid collision.

grids.dashboard: MODE B: The Control Room Grid (tight gaps gap-4, high density) for indexing dashboard.
grids.search_results: Single column editorial width (max-w-4xl) centered in screen, left-aligned text to mimic Perplexity focus.

spacing_and_layout.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). border-collapse style layouts with 1px borders, NO soft drop shadows. Sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm).

components.search_hero: Massive, screen-centered initially. On query, transitions smoothly to sticky header. Input: text-2xl or 3xl, pure white bg, 1px border, stark #002FA7 ring on focus. Minimalist icon.
components.ai_answer: Cardless. Clean indented block. Left border 2px #002FA7. Include blinking cursor for loading/streaming state.
components.citations: Superscript inline buttons [1], [2] referencing sources. Hovering shows a small, sharp tooltip with the file snippet.
components.filters: Rectangular chips. Inactive: bg-transparent border-gray-200. Active: bg-black text-white.
components.indexing_dashboard: Bento style. Use tabular numbers (JetBrains Mono). Sharp 1px borders. Display stats cleanly.
components.file_viewer: IDE-like. JetBrains Mono for code. Syntax highlighting with high-contrast theme. Markdown text uses IBM Plex Sans.
components.navigation: Clean, flat top bar. Logo on left, navigation on right. Solid background with a hard bottom border.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Explicit text and bg color shifts. Sharp, fast transitions (duration-150).
motion_and_interactions.page: Use Framer Motion for the search bar transitioning from center to top header smoothly.
motion_and_interactions.ai_loading: Use a technical typing indicator or skeleton text, not a generic spinner.

media_and_assets.icons: Install and use `@phosphor-icons/react` or `iconoir-react` for thin, technical line-work.

images.description: Architectural glass background. Use with heavy white overlay (bg-white/95) so it's just a very subtle structural texture behind the hero search.
Minimalist white server rack, use for 'Indexing...' or 'Empty Database' states in the dashboard.

accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on their role.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text against backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building for a React/Tailwind/Shadcn environment using .js files.
Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or generic default fonts. Add Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, and JetBrains Mono via CDN/imports in the global css.
Focus on pure HTML/Tailwind for the structural layout. Use customized Shadcn for dropdowns, tooltips, dialogs.
Build the dashboard using pure CSS grid (or tailwind grid cols) without nesting excessive wrappers.
Implement the Perplexity-style AI Answer citation UI meticulously. High technical precision is required.
